cases.meaning: Canonical exact-match count. This is the number A2 requires.
COVER is an exact grammar alias of COVERAGE, not a prefix match. Identical result.
Substring match: inflated by Merck KGaA and friends. A2's wrong answer.
The full name without FullMatch is still wrong (2170, not 1841) — the operator, not the phrase, is what makes it exact.
Dropping AREA[LeadSponsorName] searches all default areas and returns 4591 with HTTP 200. The AREA[] prefix is mandatory.
FullMatch against an unquoted partial token is a legitimate 0 (no sponsor is named exactly "Merck"), returned with HTTP 200. Confirmation of a discovered label must pass the label verbatim.
